label: Mild yoghurt
comment: Yoghurt without the sharper of its two bacteria, gentler ones in its place.

about.text: Yoghurt made with milder-souring cultures, often Lactobacillus acidophilus and bifidobacteria, in place of the usual Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus, and often sold for its probiotic bacteria. Less sour than ordinary yoghurt; in Germany sold as Joghurt mild.

how.text: S. thermophilus still makes most of the acid, but L. delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus is replaced by gentler lactobacilli such as L. acidophilus, and probiotic strains are added together with the starter. L. delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus is the main producer of acetaldehyde, yoghurt's key flavour, so leaving it out gives a milder yoghurt.
